projects.name: BufferLogic manual functionality review
projects.description: Nine ordered review sections. Open this tracker in one browser window and perform the tests in a separate window/workspace. Save both separately so test actions do not overwrite the review tracker.

tasks.name: 1. Create a project
tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.
tasks.completionCriteria: All checks reviewed; failures documented in task comments with expected and actual results, screenshot reference, and saved reproducing workspace.
tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: In a separate test workspace, click New project, name it Release One, and create it.
Confirm the project appears with No tasks yet rather than a completion forecast.
Confirm the schedule start date is correct.
Save the empty test workspace and reopen it. Confirm the project remains.

tasks.name: 2. Add resources
tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.
tasks.completionCriteria: All checks reviewed; failures documented in task comments with expected and actual results, screenshot reference, and saved reproducing workspace.
tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: In the test workspace, add Developer and Tester in Resources & calendars.
Confirm each defaults to 40 hours: eight hours Monday–Friday.
Try adding Developer again. Confirm a duplicate is rejected.
Change Tester to four hours each weekday. Confirm its weekly total is 20 hours.

tasks.name: 3. Add tasks and dependencies
tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.
tasks.completionCriteria: All checks reviewed; failures documented in task comments with expected and actual results, screenshot reference, and saved reproducing workspace.
tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: Create Design: Developer, good/P20 1 day, poor/P80 2 days, no predecessors.
Create Build: Developer, good/P20 3 days, poor/P80 5 days, depending on Design using its generated ID.
Create Test: Tester, good/P20 1 day, poor/P80 2 days, depending on Build using its generated ID.
Confirm unique IDs, the correct project, and correct names, resources, estimates and dependencies.
Try an unknown dependency ID. Confirm an understandable error.
Add a fourth task with no resource. Confirm it visibly shows Unassigned.
Save and reopen that draft. Confirm the fourth task remains unassigned.
Assign the fourth task to Developer and recalculate.

tasks.name: 4. Review the schedule
tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.
tasks.completionCriteria: All checks reviewed; failures documented in task comments with expected and actual results, screenshot reference, and saved reproducing workspace.
tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: Confirm Design finishes before Build starts, and Build finishes before Test starts.
Confirm the timeline shows Design → Build → Test dependency links.
Confirm Developer tasks do not overlap at 100% allocation.
Confirm P50 ≤ P80 ≤ P95 ≤ P98 ≤ P99 for the completion forecast.
Switch Time display between days and dates. Confirm assignments do not change.
Increase Build estimates and recalculate. Confirm duration and downstream forecasts respond.

tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.

tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: Select Build in Task checklists and add two checklist items.
Edit one checklist item and mark the other complete.
Remove one checklist item.
Confirm checking an item does not automatically complete the task or change its duration.
Recalculate, save and reopen. Confirm checklist edits remain.

tasks.name: 6. Test resource reassignment and deletion
tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.
tasks.completionCriteria: All checks reviewed; failures documented in task comments with expected and actual results, screenshot reference, and saved reproducing workspace.
tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: Add an unused resource named Backup.
Recalculate. Confirm Backup remains listed.
Reassign a task from Developer to Backup. Confirm Developer remains listed.
Click Delete for Backup, then Cancel. Confirm nothing changes.
Delete Backup and confirm. Verify its affected task becomes Unassigned.
Recalculate. Confirm assignments are requested and no new completion forecast is provided.
Reassign the task to an existing resource and recalculate successfully.

tasks.name: 7. Test multiple projects and priorities
tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.
tasks.completionCriteria: All checks reviewed; failures documented in task comments with expected and actual results, screenshot reference, and saved reproducing workspace.
tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: Create Release Two. Confirm Release One and its tasks remain intact.
Add an independent task in Release Two using Developer.
Recalculate and note the task order.
Move Release Two above Release One and recalculate. Confirm eligible shared-resource work responds to project priority.
Put Release Two on hold and recalculate. Confirm unstarted, unlocked work is suspended and capacity becomes available.
Resume Release Two and recalculate. Confirm its work returns.

tasks.name: 8. Test progress, deadlines and calendars
tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.

tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: Mark a task In progress; enter a valid actual start and remaining estimates; recalculate.
Mark that task Complete with valid actual dates. Confirm dependent work respects its actual finish.
Set an early project deadline. Confirm a warning appears without automatically moving tasks.
Add a zero-hour calendar exception on a future working day and recalculate. Confirm affected work moves around it.
Confirm custom weekly hours remain after recalculating and reopening.

tasks.description: Run these checks in a separate test workspace. Keep this workspace as the review tracker. Estimates default to 1–2 working hours per section; adjust to your needs.
tasks.completionCriteria: All checks reviewed; failures documented in task comments with expected and actual results, screenshot reference, and saved reproducing workspace.
tasks.comments: Results: record PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED here. Leave failed or untested checklist items unchecked; mark a task Complete in Progress only when ready.

checklist.text: Recalculate and save the finished test workspace.
Refresh the test browser window and reopen the saved test workspace.
Confirm project names, order and hold status remain.
Confirm task names, assignments, dependencies and estimates remain.
Confirm checklists, progress, deadlines and calendars remain.
Confirm scheduling still works after reopening.
Save this manual-review tracking workspace with its checklist results and comments.
